requirements.label: 学历
requirements.text: 认可本科；需中等程度IT/IS或商科知识，可通过本科课程或相关经验体现。
requirements.english: Recognised bachelor’s degree/equivalent. Intermediate IT/IS or business knowledge: relevant undergraduate courses or work experience.

requirements.label: 英语
requirements.text: 非英语授课学历：TOEFL旧制79/新制4、IELTS6或CET6 450，亦可考虑同等资格。IELTS6/TOEFL4须英语面试；托福报告可比总分≥79可能豁免。
requirements.english: Non-English-medium qualification: TOEFL before 21 January 2026 ≥79; from that date ≥4. IELTS overall ≥6.0; CET-6 ≥450; equivalent qualifications also considered. IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 4: English interview required; TOEFL comparable overall ≥79 may qualify for exemption.

requirements.label: 语言限制
requirements.text: 不接受TOEFL Home Edition/MyBest及IELTS Online/Indicator/One Skill Retake；托福送分3401。雅思电子送分至City University of Hong Kong - Graduate School；考试须在申请期开始前2年内。
requirements.english: Excluded: TOEFL Home Edition/MyBest; IELTS Indicator/One Skill Retake/Online. TOEFL recipient: 3401. IELTS delivery: City University of Hong Kong - Graduate School. Test date: within 2 years before application-period opening.

requirements.label: 文书与推荐信
requirements.text: 公开项目页面未明确PS及推荐信数量；在P85网申材料清单核对，不能当作无需。
requirements.english: Personal statement and reference count: not specified on the public page; check the application portal for P85.

requirements.label: 材料
requirements.text: 学历、含GPA/均分成绩单、适用语言成绩；内地学历需相应学信网验证。支持文件上传系统，不接受邮件/邮寄提交。
requirements.english: Degree certificate; transcript including overall GPA/average marks; applicable English report; mainland-degree verification through CSSD where relevant. Supporting documents: upload through the portal; not by email/post.

requirements.label: 费用
requirements.english: Tuition: HK$393,000.

requirements.label: 申请费
requirements.text: 每个项目HK$600。
requirements.english: Application fee per programme: HK$600.

deadlines.label: 非本地申请最终截止；滚动录取

notes: 项目代码P85；用户内部提交目标11月25日。
申请入口为官方Apply Now页；直接登录地址因403未能核实，进入该页后选择登录。
优秀申请人奖学金HK$50,000；具体获奖和申请程序以项目通知为准。

name: M.S.Ed. Learning Sciences and Technologies

requirements.label: 学历
requirements.text: 入学前取得本科或同等学位；GRE不要求且不审阅。
requirements.english: Baccalaureate degree (U.S. regionally accredited institution or equivalent), completed before matriculation. GRE: not required; not considered.

requirements.label: 文书
requirements.text: SOP≤750词；提交当前CV。
requirements.english: Statement of Purpose: maximum 750 words. Current résumé/CV required.

requirements.label: 推荐信
requirements.text: 3封；优先由推荐人通过其邮箱在线直接提交。
requirements.english: Letters of Recommendation: 3. Online submission directly from the recommender’s email address strongly preferred; submission protocol verified.

requirements.label: 成绩认证
requirements.text: 海外学历／课程需NACES成员机构逐科认证并直送。学校提示可能需8—12周，应立即启动。
requirements.english: International coursework: NACES member agency course-by-course evaluation, sent directly by the agency. Processing may take 8–12 weeks.

requirements.label: 英语
requirements.text: 非英语母语需TOEFL/IELTS；全英文授课本／硕士学位可适用豁免。公开页未列统一最低分；代码2943。
requirements.english: TOEFL iBT / IELTS required for non-native English speakers, unless exempt. Exemption: undergraduate or graduate degree taught solely in English. TOEFL code: 2943. Minimum score: not specified on this public page; check the application portal.

requirements.label: 申请费
requirements.text: 无申请费。
requirements.english: There is no application fee to apply to Penn GSE.

deadlines.label: 优先截止（完整申请获最充分录取／奖学金考虑）；之后有位才滚动

notes: 先核实已有学历认证能否用于Penn；只有原始海外成绩单不算完成认证。

name: Master of Industrial and Labor Relations (MILR)

requirements.label: 学历与考试
requirements.text: 认可本科或国际同等学历；不设统一GPA淘汰线；GRE/GMAT不审阅。
requirements.english: Accredited bachelor’s degree or international equivalent. No GPA cut-off specified. GRE/GMAT: not reviewed.

requirements.label: 文书
requirements.text: Academic SOP＋Personal Statement两份；ASOP通用建议1—2页，最终以网申题目为准。
requirements.english: Academic Statement of Purpose + Personal Statement. Graduate School ASOP guidance: typically 1–2 pages unless the program specifies otherwise; check portal instructions.

requirements.label: 推荐信
requirements.text: 2封，学术／职业均可；通过网申提交。
requirements.english: Two letters of recommendation are required. Academic or professional recommendations are accepted.

requirements.label: 材料
requirements.text: CV、所有就读院校成绩单；录取接受后提交正式成绩单。
requirements.english: Resume + unofficial transcripts from every college/university attended. Official electronic transcripts required after accepting an offer.

requirements.label: 视频面试
requirements.text: 提交申请后由邮件邀请录制；不要把交表视为材料已齐。
requirements.english: Recorded online video interview: invitation and instructions emailed after application submission.

requirements.label: 资助
requirements.text: 希望争取资助需Funding Consideration Statement。
requirements.english: Funding consideration: submit a funding consideration statement.

requirements.label: 英语
requirements.text: 官网2026—27暂行：IELTS7；旧TOEFL S22/R20/L15/W20；新制S4/R4/L3.5/W4。页面限定2026—27，2027秋适用性应再确认。
requirements.english: Published professional-master’s thresholds, labelled 2026–27 only: IELTS Academic ≥7.0; pre-January-2026 TOEFL S22/R20/L15/W20; updated TOEFL S4/R4/L3.5/W4. Confirm applicability to Fall 2027.

deadlines.label: 2027秋奖学金考虑截止；页面未列另一最终截止

notes: ApplyWeb入口来自学校官方链接；自动读取受登录跳转限制，可用官网“Apply Now”进入。
语言分数不是新制总分门槛；须逐项检查。

name: MS in Information Systems and Artificial Intelligence for Business

requirements.label: 学历与考试
requirements.text: 本科；GRE/GMAT可选；工作经验非必需。
requirements.english: Bachelor’s degree, earned or in progress. GMAT/GRE: optional. Work experience: not required.

requirements.label: 文书
requirements.text: 2篇，每篇300—500词；12号字、双倍行距；第2篇从网申题目中选。
requirements.english: Two required essays, 300–500 words each; 12-point font, double-spaced. Essay 1: required topic; Essay 2: choose from application topics.

requirements.label: 推荐信
requirements.text: 必需1封，最多读2封；优先工作邮箱，推荐人须了解你的学习／工作。
requirements.english: One recommendation is required. We will read up to two.

requirements.label: 材料
requirements.text: 更新CV（工作起止年月）、成绩单；海外学位需NACES逐科认证。
requirements.english: Current resume/CV with employment months and years; required transcripts; non-U.S. degrees require an official NACES course-by-course evaluation.

requirements.label: 视频面试
requirements.text: Kira内置网申，截止前完成。
requirements.english: Kira video interview: required for this full-time MS program; part of the application and must be completed before the deadline.

requirements.label: 英语
requirements.text: 偏好最低旧TOEFL100（接受MyBest）／IELTS7；全英文授课学位可申请豁免。新制门槛未在该页明确。
requirements.english: Preferred minimums: TOEFL 100 (MyBest accepted), IELTS 7.0, PTE 70, DET 130. English-only degree instruction may qualify for exemption. Updated 1–6 TOEFL threshold: not specified on this public page; check the application portal.

requirements.label: 申请费
requirements.text: US$100，不退。
requirements.english: Application fee: USD 100, nonrefundable.

deadlines.label: 第3轮，国际生强烈建议最迟此轮
第4轮，需首次F-1签证的国际生最终轮

notes: 同一轮不能同时申请多个Carey专业硕士；递交后仍需检查材料是否齐全。

name: MS in Information Management

requirements.label: 学历
requirements.text: 本科，不限专业。
requirements.english: While a bachelor's degree is required for admission, your degree can be in any discipline.

requirements.label: GRE／GMAT
requirements.text: GRE/GMAT可选；不提交不会处于不利地位。
requirements.english: GRE/GMAT: optional. Applicants without scores are not disadvantaged in holistic review.

requirements.label: 主文书
requirements.text: ≤1000词，12号Arial、单倍行距；背景准备、目标与项目匹配。
requirements.english: Personal statement: maximum 1,000 words; 12pt Arial; single-spaced. Address preparation, goals/program fit, and academic interests.

requirements.label: 网申短答
requirements.text: 统一网申另有2道必答Personal Statement，各≤250词；另2道可选。
requirements.english: Graduate application Personal Statements: Questions 1–2 required; Questions 3–4 optional. Maximum 250 words per answer.

requirements.label: 推荐信
requirements.text: 3封；毕业距入学不足3年者，至少1封来自授课教师；推荐人在线上传。
requirements.english: Three reference letters. If graduating within three years of intended enrollment: at least one from a faculty member who taught you. Recommenders upload online.

requirements.label: 材料
requirements.text: CV、各校成绩单及必要翻译、学位证（若成绩单未注明授予）。
requirements.english: Resume/CV; transcripts from all post-secondary institutions, translations where needed, and diploma/degree certificate if the transcript does not record the awarded degree.

requirements.label: 英语
requirements.text: 新TOEFL：limited4.0/full5.0；旧79/103；IELTS6.5/7.5。低于full须入学语言测试；不接受MyBest。
requirements.english: Limited / full admission: updated TOEFL 4.0 / 5.0; earlier TOEFL 79 / 103; IELTS 6.5 / 7.5. Below full status: English Placement Test required. MyBest not accepted.

requirements.label: 申请费
requirements.text: US$90；须在截止前付款，否则提交会撤回。
requirements.english: Application fee: USD 90. Payment required before program deadline; unpaid application becomes unsubmitted.

deadlines.label: 早申截止，美国中部时间22:59
早申推荐信截止，美国中部时间22:59

notes: 主文书之外必须安排两道250词短答。

name: Master of Human Resource Management (MHRM)

requirements.label: 学历与考试
requirements.text: 四年本科或同等；不限专业，无必需工作经验／先修课；GRE/GMAT可选。
requirements.english: Four-year bachelor’s degree or equivalent. All majors welcome. No required post-undergraduate work experience or prerequisite courses. GMAT/GRE optional.

requirements.label: 文书
requirements.text: 目标Essay建议≤750词；补充解释Essay可选≤500词。
requirements.english: Goals essay: recommended maximum 750 words. Optional supplemental essay: recommended maximum 500 words.

requirements.label: 推荐人与推荐信
requirements.text: 填写2名reference；推荐信可选。若提交，推荐人可直邮FCOB-grad_apps@osu.edu并写申请ID。
requirements.english: Two references required; recommendation letters optional. Recommenders may email FCOB-grad_apps@osu.edu directly, including the application ID.

requirements.label: 材料
requirements.text: CV、所有获得学分院校成绩单；检查网申完整清单。
requirements.english: Resume; official transcripts from every institution where academic credit was earned. Complete the application-portal checklist.

requirements.label: 视频面试
requirements.text: 必需Kira；开申请收到邀请，建议2周内做完，未完成不审核。
requirements.english: Kira recorded video assessment required. Invitation follows application start; completion within two weeks recommended. Application review waits for all items, including Kira.

requirements.label: 英语
requirements.text: Fisher页列旧TOEFL79／新4.0，IELTS7；不接受MyBest；正式成绩须到达才审核。
requirements.english: Published minimum recommended scores: TOEFL 79 / updated TOEFL 4.0; IELTS Academic 7.0; DET 120. Official scores required before review. TOEFL MyBest not accepted.

requirements.label: 申请费
requirements.text: 国际生US$70。
requirements.english: International application fee: USD 70, nonrefundable.

deadlines.label: 资助／奖学金优先1；要求全套材料齐

notes: 官方AI政策允许构思、语法校对等辅助，要求披露；不允许提交AI生成的申请正文。

name: PhD in Management — Organization and Human Resources

requirements.label: 学历与考试
requirements.text: 本科同等学历；学校通用GPA3.0或等效；GRE/GMAT建议但非必需。
requirements.english: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent. University baseline: GPA 3.0 / B-grade or equivalent. Management PhD: GRE/GMAT recommended, not required.

requirements.label: 文书
requirements.text: SOP约700词，解释读博原因；PDF并写全名。
requirements.english: Statement of purpose: approximately 700 words; reasons for doctoral study; PDF bearing the full name used in the application.

requirements.label: 写作样本
requirements.text: 另交独立作者英文写作样本≤5页，PDF、全名；不能用SOP代替。
requirements.english: Separate English writing sample: single author, maximum five pages, PDF with full name and writing-sample designation. Must be distinct from the SOP.

requirements.label: 推荐信
requirements.text: 2封；填写邮箱触发邀请，推荐人直接上传PDF，申请人代传无效。
requirements.english: Two letters required. Recommenders receive email invitations and upload PDFs directly; applicant-submitted letters are invalid.

requirements.label: 材料
requirements.text: CV需工作起止年月及最近两段工作电话／邮箱；各就读院校成绩单PDF。
requirements.english: Resume: employment month/year ranges, telephone and email contacts for the two most recent workplaces. PDF transcripts for all undergraduate/graduate credits.

requirements.label: 英语
requirements.text: 学校通用旧TOEFL79／新4.0（接受MyBest）、IELTS6.5；管理PhD页指向此要求。正式成绩直送，审核时在2年内。
requirements.english: University minimums: TOEFL 79 / updated TOEFL 4.0 (MyBest accepted), IELTS 6.5. Scores sent by the testing agency; valid within two years of International Admissions review.

requirements.label: 申请费
requirements.english: Application fee: USD 100, nonrefundable.

requirements.label: 国际生补充
requirements.text: 护照照片页PDF；非英文成绩单附正式译文。
requirements.english: Passport photo page: PDF. Transcripts not issued in English require official English translations.

deadlines.label: 最终截止，所有材料含推荐信必须齐

notes: 早交申请通常应30天内补齐，且不得晚于最终截止。
外部学历认证不能替代原学校成绩单；无需为Buffalo专门做认证。

name: PhD in Industrial Relations and Human Resources — Human Resources

requirements.label: 学历与考试
requirements.text: 不要求已有硕士；重视研究经历；GRE/GMAT建议但非必需。
requirements.english: Terminal master’s degree not required. Research experience/training considered important. GRE/GMAT recommended, not required.

requirements.label: 文书
requirements.text: PS约500词；明确Human Resources方向、研究问题及具体导师匹配。
requirements.english: Personal statement: approximately 500 words. Name the Human Resources or Labor, Work, and Society concentration; describe research interests and faculty fit.

requirements.label: 推荐信
requirements.text: 3封，学术联系推荐人权重较高；具体上传邀请以网申为准。
requirements.english: Three recommendation letters; academic connections/background receive greater weight. Submission workflow: check application-portal instructions.

requirements.label: 写作样本
requirements.text: 可选但强烈建议，尤其毕业论文／研究论文。
requirements.english: A writing sample is highly recommended (especially a Master's or Honors thesis if completed)

requirements.label: 材料
requirements.text: CV、各就读院校正式成绩单；项目编号16545。
requirements.english: Resume; official transcripts from every post-secondary institution. Program number: 16545.

requirements.label: 英语
requirements.text: 中央最低旧TOEFL W22/S23/R21/L17；新W4.5/S4.5/R4/L4；IELTS7。正式成绩直送；豁免按中央规定。
requirements.english: Central minimums: earlier TOEFL W22/S23/R21/L17; updated TOEFL W4.5/S4.5/R4/L4; IELTS overall 7. Official scores sent by testing agency. Exemptions follow central admissions policy.

requirements.label: 申请费
requirements.english: Application fee: USD 70.

deadlines.label: 秋季年度截止；官网按每年1月5日列示

notes: 旧制口语最低23；先完成文书、核实语言豁免，必要时新托福出分后补送。
学院页语言有效期写5年，与中央2年（入学起算）冲突；按较严格中央要求准备并询问学院。
